mines.mine_notes: Southeastern Wyoming, ~20 miles west of Cheyenne, on Wyoming state land. Feasibility study results announced March 2026 (Micon International; S-K 1300 reserves effective ~Mar 30, 2026): proven + probable reserves 74.5 Mst = 1,015 koz Au, 260 Mlb Cu, 3,031 koz Ag = 1,598 koz AuEq. FS: 11-yr LOM; avg LOM sales ~85 koz AuEq/yr; total cash costs ~US$1,748/oz AuEq; after-tax NPV5% US$632.0M (@ prevailing metal prices at time of study, ~US$3,250/oz Au); after-tax IRR 27%; initial capital US$394M + US$28M pre-production owners' costs. All permits required to begin construction secured; US$5.0M reclamation bond in place. Earlier Dec 2021 PFS (Gustavson/WSP) established first reserves; Feb 2025 PFS update. Development-stage; no production. FY2026 (ended Apr 30, 2026): no revenues; operating expenses $19.0M; cash $30.7M; working capital $31.6M; accumulated net losses $110.6M; substantial doubt about going concern without significant external financing. Dec 2025 private placement raised $31.2M (1,922,159 shares @ $16.25 + warrants @ $23.00). First production targeted as early as late 2028, subject to financing.
